text: $100The ConversationFunds the door-to-door work that wins a tossup. One hundred dollars helps our volunteers reach undecided households in Plano and Allen, one honest conversation at a time.Give $100

$250The AirwavesCarries the message beyond the doorstep. Two hundred and fifty dollars helps place the digital and local advertising that reaches the voters a knock cannot, with the same measured tone George brings to everything.Give $250

$25The IntroductionPuts George's record into the hands of neighbors who have not met him yet. Twenty-five dollars helps print and mail the literature that introduces a judge to the voters he hopes to represent.Give $25

$500The Ground GamePowers the get-out-the-vote effort in the final stretch. Five hundred dollars helps organize the phones, the reminders, and the rides that turn support into ballots when early voting opens October 19.Give $500
